reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 coding agent, drafted on operator instruction. The operator confirms or rejects this review when recording the admission decision.
source_kind: web crawl (Common Crawl derived); not a blend that packages benchmark datasets
global_decontamination_evidence: none: the dataset card states no decontamination against these or any benchmarks

per_benchmark.BLiMP: Template-generated minimal pairs published in public repositories; crawled copies are possible.
per_benchmark.ARC-Easy: Science exam questions circulate on public web pages; crawled copies are possible, and the essential_science view raises the relevant density.
per_benchmark.HellaSwag: Contexts derive from ActivityNet captions and WikiHow; WikiHow pages are ordinary crawl content.
per_benchmark.PIQA: Derived from instructables-style how-to content, which is ordinary crawl content and matches the essential_practical view.

sample_measurement: none: no Essential-Web text has been scanned against benchmark text
gate_value_meaning: Acquisition and pretraining eligibility with possible contamination and a bound C05 obligation. No zero-contamination claim. C05 screening is required before tokenizer/gradient training; official benchmark claims require a protected receipt matching the frozen canonical training pool and reported matcher limitations.

existing_mechanism.contract: C05: exclude all benchmark splits from gradient and tokenizer training, matching full examples and sufficiently informative spans; EVALUATION_POLICY.md: isolated final exclusion with opaque receipts.
existing_mechanism.code: xlm.data.exclusion (BenchmarkExclusionMatcher, ExclusionConfig, FinalExclusionReceipt); pool manifests record exclusion_policy_identity.
limits: Development-mode matching over locally available benchmark text; it cannot detect paraphrases.
The matcher holds the scanned documents in memory and tests every indexed span against every document. It has not been run or sized for the Mix-01 pool.
No command applies it during Mix-01 pool freeze; a pool frozen without it records exclusion_policy_identity 'none_declared'.

mitigation: Before tokenizer fitting and training, run C05 benchmark exclusion over the retained canonical Essential subset (full-example hash and informative-span matching) and record the exclusion policy identity and receipt in the pool manifest.
Matched documents are dropped at that stage. No row is dropped now on suspicion alone.
Until an exclusion receipt over the frozen pool exists, benchmark results on a model trained on this data are reported as possibly contaminated.
condition_for_uncontaminated_claim: A C05 exclusion receipt over the frozen training pool, with the stated matcher limits reported alongside the result.
